06 /13.08.2024: I.A. No.7091 of 2024 This interlocutory application has been filed by the appellant,
praying therein to suspend the sentence and release him on bail during the pendency of this appeal.

2. The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Sections 376-D, 366, 323, 341, 342, 379,
411 and 120(B) of IPC, in connection with Sessions Trial Case No.668 of 2019.

He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life term for reminder period of natural life till his last breaths with a fine of Rs.50,000/- for the offence under Section 376-D of IPC along with other sentences.

3. Heard, learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P. for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. The appellant is one of the accused, who is involved in the commission of offence under Section 376-D of IPC.
6. There is direct involvement of this appellant, who was driving the vehicle in which she was kidnapped before the commission of rape.
All the bail applications of the co-accused have been dismissed.
7. Considering the aforesaid fact, we are not inclined to release the appellant on bail.
